ModMetaData.name: Age of Migrations: Late Rome
ModMetaData.author: syneezvetik
ModMetaData.description:
The armies of the late Roman Empire, around 400-450 AD, in RimWorld style.
Western Empire: - Ridge helmet and gilded officer's ridge helmet - Red tunic and red military cloak
Eastern Empire: - Spangenhelm with mail neck guard - White-and-purple tunic and purple military cloak
Shared: - Lorica hamata (mail), lorica squamata (iron and gilded scale) - Spatha, gilded spatha, hasta spear, kontos cavalry lance (hits harder the faster you charge) - Plumbata darts, spiculum javelin, sling and arcuballista (hand crossbow) - Oval and round shields in western and eastern colors. Shields are worn in their own slot, so they work with any weapon, and they block arrows, bullets and some melee hits from the front.
Armor and weapons are made at the smithy (needs Smithing), clothes at the tailoring bench.
Cavalry: with Giddy-Up 2 - Continued installed, Roman light cavalry, horse archers and cataphracts ride into battle, and your colonists can ride horses too. Without it, they fight on foot.
Each empire has one imperial capital, Ravenna and Constantinopolis, marked on the world map: a huge walled city with a palace, hippodrome, forum and over a hundred citizens and soldiers.
Settlements: Roman marching camps (palisade, leather tents, praetorium, horse lines) and walled towns (forum, basilica, houses with atriums, baths, barracks), built from new Roman walls, floors, columns, standards, statues and braziers that you can build yourself too.
Work in progress: more peoples of the migration era are coming.
